runners_data.name: Thunderstorm Katie
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who must overcome traffic concerns but trainer Jim Goldie is in good form with recent winners

runners_data.name: Tarlac
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with useful 7lb claimer discount but trainer Katie Scott winless in last 8 attempts

runners_data.name: Beerwah
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form including two wins, weighted to go close despite wide draw concerns

runners_data.name: Kyber Crystal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying top weight headgear for first time, recent 5f form suggests ready for another bold show

runners_data.name: Wee Mary
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with lightest weight and useful apprentice allowance, must navigate traffic but stays strongly

runners_data.name: Until Dawn
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner with sustainable style, hard hat applied suggests connections addressing previous focus issues

runners_data.name: Sixcor
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner getting significant weight relief, needs to overcome moderate recent form at this level

runners_data.name: Ski Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with consistent 5f record, trainer struggles but horse's individual form suggests competitiveness

runners_data.name: Classy Clarets

races.paceDynamic: Until Dawn stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the front without early pressure. Four horses (Thornaby Pearl, Tarlac, Kyber Crystal, Sixcor, Ski Angel) want prominent positions creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up brigade (Thunderstorm Katie, Beerwah, Wee Mary, Classy Clarets) will face the challenge of weaving through traffic in a short 5f sprint. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and early prominent racers who can secure clear racing room before the final 2f scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn jumps cleanly and establishes an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets first run on the field while prominent runners clash behind, creating the perfect scenario for a wire-to-wire victory. Until Dawn's sustainable pace style perfectly suits controlling this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners create early scrimmaging and interference
scenarios.body: The congestion allows a patient hold-up horse to find the clearest path and strike late when others are hampered by traffic. Skilled navigation becomes crucial in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn goes too fast early or prominent horses apply unexpected pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up a closing kick finish where hold-up horses benefit from the strong gallop. Late runners get their ideal scenario despite the short trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners engage Until Dawn from the start creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The honest gallop throughout favours horses with proven stamina and finishing speed over pure sprint merchants. Form horses with tactical speed excel.

watchPoints.text: Watch for scrimmaging at the 3f pole where Thornaby Pearl, Tarlac, Kyber Crystal, Sixcor, and Ski Angel converge seeking prominent positions
Monitor Until Dawn's early fractions - if pressured by prominent runners the pace could collapse quickly in final furlong
Observe Beerwah's position turning for home as connections often produce big-priced winners when least expected
Check Wee Mary's passage 2f out as her hold-up style needs clear running to be effective over this minimum trip
Watch for Thunderstorm Katie finding racing room as Jim Goldie's 3 from 26 strike rate shows stable in decent form

races.name: British EBF Supporting Racing Welfare #mentalhealthawarenessweek Restricted Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Prime Secure William Wallace Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Harriet Quimby
runners_data.note: Natural leader with winning form but faces tactical disadvantage against another confirmed front runner

runners_data.name: My Ballyquinn
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with ideal tactical position but needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick

runners_data.name: Gaelic Approach
runners_data.note: Front running style but carrying lowest weight and has recent winning form over course and distance

races.paceDynamic: Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach will clash from the start as both are natural leaders, creating a genuine pace battle in this small field. With My Ballyquinn preferring to settle at the back, the front two will likely engage early and maintain a strong gallop throughout the 1m3f trip. The honest tempo they set will test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horse My Ballyquinn, who can track the pace duel and benefit from the inevitable weakening of the early leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach burn each other out with their early pace battle
scenarios.body: My Ballyquinn can use superior tactical positioning to sweep past the tiring leaders in the final furlong. The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for the closer.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can establish a soft lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more manageable and allows the front runner to maintain enough in reserve for the finish. Class could tell.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical stalemate develops
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are too respectful of each other early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes falsely run and turns into a sprint finish where natural speed matters most. The race loses its staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners go too fast too early and completely empty
scenarios.body: My Ballyquinn wins easily but the race becomes a crawl from halfway with all three horses struggling. Time would be very slow.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach engage in a destructive early battle that compromises both
Watch My Ballyquinn's position early - needs to be close enough if the pace becomes moderate
Watch for any tactical restraint from the front runners which could neutralise My Ballyquinn's advantage
Watch the pace through the middle sections - this trip demands stamina reserves for the finish
Watch Connor Beasley's ride on Gaelic Approach as he knows the track well and won here recently

races.name: Precon Braveheart Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Humble Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid recent form but needs to overcome 5lb claimer Amie Waugh's inexperience in this tactical contest.

runners_data.name: Majestic
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse whose poor recent form and heavy 132lbs burden make him vulnerable despite proven ability on similar going.

runners_data.name: Urban Road
runners_data.note: Sharp hold-up performer with excellent recent form including two seconds, well-handicapped on 116lbs with promising 5lb claimer Rhys Elliott.

runners_data.name: Ouro Preto
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 223-day break but trainer Iain Jardine's poor recent form (1/23) raises fitness concerns despite previous course success.

runners_data.name: Antrim
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner whose 42-day break and Burke stable's decent form make him the logical pace-setter, though 133lbs is no gift.

runners_data.name: Tiernan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid official rating returning from 188-day layoff, but needs to prove fitness after lengthy absence for in-form connections.

runners_data.name: Elsass
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent winning form and decent weight allocation, though Charlie Johnston's inconsistent 14-day record (6/43) is concerning.

races.paceDynamic: Antrim will be the sole early leader with Ouro Preto sitting prominently behind, creating a sustainable tempo in this small field of seven. The lack of pace pressure means Antrim can dictate terms through steady fractions, with five hold-up horses (Humble Spark, Majestic, Urban Road, Tiernan, Elsass) tracking from behind. This shape creates a tactical race where the front two can control the gallop without being harassed early. The strong bias toward hold-up runners and weak early pace clearly favours closers who can unleash late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Antrim maintains an uncontested lead with Ouro Preto tracking in second
scenarios.body: The front two can nurse their advantage through comfortable splits and prove hard to peg back when the closers rally. Antrim's class edge at the weights or Ouro Preto's fresh return from a break could be decisive when they're not softened up by early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Overwhelms
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too sedate and the hold-up horses get perfect racing room
scenarios.body: The closers will sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong with Urban Road and Elsass best positioned to capitalize. Their superior recent form and lighter weights make them dangerous when getting first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ouro Preto moves early from his stalking position to challenge Antrim
scenarios.body: The fresh legs from his 223-day break allow Ouro Preto to sustain a long drive while the hold-up horses are caught too far back. His previous course winner's instincts prove crucial when positioned perfectly behind the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Tiernan or Humble Spark produce career-best finishing efforts from the back
scenarios.body: One of the more unfancied closers finds significant improvement stepping back up in trip and overwhelms the field. Their superior official ratings finally translate to winning form when everything falls right tactically.

watchPoints.text: Antrim's early speed could be compromised if Sam James tries to restrain him rather than utilizing his natural front-running style.
Urban Road and Elsass both need clear runs in the straight as hold-up horses in a small field where traffic problems are less likely but still possible.
Ouro Preto's 223-day absence makes his fitness a major question mark despite being well-positioned tactically behind the leader.
Tiernan's 188-day break combined with Paul Mulrennan's booking suggests confidence in his well-being after the extended rest.
The 5lb claiming allowances for Amie Waugh and Rhys Elliott could prove decisive in a tight handicap finish.

races.paceDynamic: Salam Dubawi looks the only genuine early pace with his prominent style, likely to lead unchallenged through steady fractions. The majority field comprises hold-up horses (Obito, Flying Fletcher, Austrian Theory, Sanafi Zabeel, Quiet Resolve, Naturalia, Tee Aitch Aye) with only Qitaal and Draupnir showing prominent tendencies to track the leader. This creates a classic scenario where one horse dictates terms up front before the cavalry charge arrives. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can steal a march before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Salam Dubawi gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to build an unassailable lead while the hold-up horses are still organizing their moves. Qitaal and Draupnir benefit from tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade time their challenges perfectly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Austrian Theory or Obito use their class advantage to sweep past a tiring leader in the dying strides. The sustainable early pace gives them the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Qitaal or Draupnir position perfectly behind Salam Dubawi and outfinish him
scenarios.body: They get the ideal trip tracking the leader before finding extra gear when it matters. The genuine pace sets up their turn of foot perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Success
scenarios.trigger: If the favorite market choices fail to deliver and a lesser-fancied runner finds the perfect trip
scenarios.body: Quiet Resolve or Flying Fletcher benefit from the strong early pace and lightweight to spring a surprise. The race sets up ideally for an each-way shock.

watchPoints.text: Salam Dubawi could steal this if he gets uncontested lead and maintains strong gallop to the line
Austrian Theory and Obito have the class to win this if they get clear runs in the straight
Quiet Resolve's 5lb apprentice claim could be significant given his winning form last time
If Qitaal tracks Salam Dubawi closely he could emerge as the biggest threat turning for home
Any signs of early pace pressure would completely change the complexion of this race

runners_data.name: Delinquent

runners_data.name: Horu Kanu

runners_data.name: Angela's Baar

runners_data.name: Saxophonist

runners_data.name: Unchartedterritory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner avoiding hold-up traffic but inconsistent recent efforts worry

races.paceDynamic: Picture Palace will lead unchallenged early with four prominent runners (Welbury, Unchartedterritory, Parole Officer, Born A Star) creating congestion behind but not pressuring the leader. The single leader scenario allows Picture Palace to dictate a measured gallop through the middle stages before the prominent quartet and hold-up brigade (Delinquent, Horu Kanu, Angela's Baar, Saxophonist, Deep Sleep) converge 2-3 furlongs out. With five hold-up horses needing room simultaneously and prominent runners potentially blocking their path, this race shape heavily favours those positioned on or near the early pace who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Holds Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Picture Palace maintains steady fractions without fierce early pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The measured gallop suits the leader's stamina while prominent runners get first run on the closers. Hold-up horses face impossible traffic problems as five of them seek the same gaps simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet bunch up turning for home creating a wall across the track
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses with room on the outside benefit while those trapped behind the prominent wall struggle. The pace collapse allows patient types to swoop if they avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Welbury and Born A Star apply serious pressure to Picture Palace from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased gallop finds out the leader's stamina while setting up the race perfectly for closers. Quality hold-up horses like Delinquent and Saxophonist benefit from the stronger pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Picture Palace builds an unassailable lead while prominent runners fail to organize pursuit
scenarios.body: The leader gets too far clear to catch despite the tactical advantage of those behind. Even with traffic problems affecting hold-up horses, the race becomes a procession.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic chaos 2f out as five hold-up horses (Delinquent, Horu Kanu, Angela's Baar, Saxophonist, Deep Sleep) converge simultaneously
Monitor if Welbury or Born A Star apply early pressure to Picture Palace which could change the entire complexion
Deep Sleep carries 7lb less than top weights and has been running well on good going recently
Angela's Baar returns from 81-day layoff which is concerning for a hold-up horse needing peak fitness for turn of foot
Picture Palace's 19-day break and inexperienced 5lb claimer could be tested if pace quickens

runners_data.name: Pisanello
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with consistent form who needs a strong pace and clear passage to be effective.

runners_data.name: Perfidia
runners_data.note: Recent winner with good going form, best of the hold-up horses but faces traffic concerns.

runners_data.name: Velvet Skies
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner switching from sprint trips to this longer distance, lacks good going experience.

runners_data.name: Nakatomi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can track Pallas Lord closely, gets significant weight relief.

runners_data.name: Hashtagnotions
runners_data.note: Handy type who showed good form before break, can sit close to the pace.

runners_data.name: Millbuie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor trainer form, gets weight relief but needs everything to fall right.

runners_data.name: Pallas Lord
runners_data.note: Only front runner returns from 59-day break, gets uncontested lead but carries top weight.

runners_data.name: Uncle Liam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form with strong jockey booking, ideally positioned tactically.

runners_data.name: Approaching Dawn
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up type with moderate ability, needs major pace collapse to feature.

races.paceDynamic: Pallas Lord is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. The prominent runners Nakatomi, Hashtagnotions and Uncle Liam will likely settle behind the leader, while the majority of the field (Pisanello, Perfidia, Velvet Skies, Millbuie, Approaching Dawn) are hold-up types who will be tracking from midfield or rear. With one lonely leader and a large contingent of hold-up horses, this sets up a tactical affair where the pace could be steady early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close enough to the leader to strike when the field bunches up, avoiding the traffic issues that will plague the many hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Steals
scenarios.trigger: If Pallas Lord gets soft fractions and isn't put under pressure until late.
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old gets first run on his rivals and proves hard to peg back despite the weight. The hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed by the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses track the leader closely and time their challenges perfectly.
scenarios.body: Nakatomi, Hashtagnotions or Uncle Liam can position ideally behind Pallas Lord and have enough left to strike. They avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and the field spreads out.
scenarios.body: One of the many hold-up types gets a clear passage and benefits from the strong gallop to show their best form. Perfidia or Pisanello could be best positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Pallas Lord sets crawling fractions and the field comes to him in a bunch.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win. This creates maximum chaos and unpredictability in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Pallas Lord gets harried early by any of the prominent runners, as he needs soft fractions to be effective.
Monitor the first quarter-mile splits - if they go too slowly, the hold-up horses will get first run on the leader.
Check how Nakatomi breaks from the stalls, as prominent runners need to avoid being shuffled back early.
Observe Uncle Liam's positioning turning for home, as he's shown best recent form of the handy types.
Watch for traffic problems in the straight affecting Perfidia and Pisanello who need clear runs.
